reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output when the cited text supports compliance; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs, so no unintended edits were introduced.
The rule's preferred position is 'no non-solicit on Customer', so the documented absence of any solicit/no-hire/inducement covenant correctly resolves to compliant rather than missing.

The cited provisions (§5.4 General Manager liaison, §10.2 no joint venture) impose no hiring or solicitation restraint, and the §6 exclusivity restraint is a competing-projects covenant binding the counterparty, properly excluded from this employee-focused rule.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are correctly explained as absence artifacts — there is no covenant text for them to match — so they do not undermine the finding.
Tone and format requirements are satisfied (no counterparty comment needed for an internal compliant evidence finding).
